If you want to repost now, reframe it as a personal report or a question (for example, "People in my neighborhood reported problems with mailed ballots — has anyone else experienced this?") or label it clearly as opinion and include links to reputable sources. Note an automated system may have flagged the post initially and a moderator reviewed it; we can’t promise outcomes, but credible evidence in your appeal will prompt escalation for further human review.
